name: What factors influence the cost of a new walkway?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a new walkway?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a new walkway is primarily influenced by its size, the chosen materials—such as premium pavers, natural stone, or stamped concrete—and the complexity of the design, including any curves, steps, or integrated lighting. Site preparation, including grading and drainage solutions, also plays a significant role in the overall investment. As part of our commitment to transparency, AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates during the design phase, detailing all aspects of the project. We focus on delivering lasting value through quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walkway costs depend on size, material (pavers, stone, concrete), design complexity, and site preparation; AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates.
